item.title: Weekend Forecast
item.description: Best surf: Cowell, Sunday, October 11 at 1 PM — 6 alone / 6.5 with instructor, the best available reading, though still below the independent worth-the-drive threshold. Best jump: Skydive California, Friday, October 9 at 9 AM — 2 mph wind with 8 mph gusts, the earliest of two tied smoothest slots. All times PDT.
